entry.name: rnbo_line
entry.description: Generate ramps and line segments from one value to another within a specified amount of time.

arguments.name: initial
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the signal output. The default value is 0.

arguments.name: grain
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the grain: the time interval at which numbers are sent out. If the grain is not specified, line outputs a number every 20 milliseconds.
